FULL TEXT:
SHAHEED UDHAM SINGH
PANJAB UNIVERSITY CONSTITUENT COLLEGE
MOHAN KE HITHAR, GURU HAR SAHAI – FEROZEPUR
E. puccghs@gmail.com puccghs.org
Reference No. SUSPUCC/ Dated: 02.04.2024
Advertisement for the Post of Peon and Schedule of Interview
Applications are invited for One Post of Peon at Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab
University Constituent College, Guru Har Sahai, Ferozepur, on D.W. basis on current
D.C. Rate. The applications complete in all respect must reach in the office of the
Principal by 15.04.2024 (03.00 PM).
Name of the Post: Peon (01).
Age, Qualification and other Norms: As per Panjab University, Chandigarh, rules.
The interview will be held on 20.04.2024 at 11.30 AM.
The candidates should report in the office of the College at 09.00 AM for the
scrutiny/verification of the particulars/certificates.
The candidates are required to bring the application form along with the essential
certificates in original and one set of photocopies of the same.
Venue: Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab University Constituent College, Guru Har Sahai,
Ferozepur.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending interview.
Dr. Sunil Khosla
Principal
